question:
Choose the set of numbers that is similar to the following set.

{12, 18, 6}
solution:
Given: {12, 18, 6}

The logic followed here is: 

 
• **Sum of all the three numbers is equal to 36, as shown below,**

{12, 18, 6} → 12 + 18 + 6 = 36
